# dya studio protocol extender CMakeLists.txt

zephyr_include_directories(include)

if(CONFIG_ZMK_FEATURE_DYA_STUDIO)
    if(CONFIG_ZMK_FEATURE_DYA_STUDIO_STUDIO_RPC)
        # C source is compiled into the app target so it inherits the app's
        # generated studio.pb.h include path (the Extension arm).
        target_sources(app PRIVATE src/dya_studio.c)

        # Module-local payload protos are generated by a dedicated nanopb
        # library. APPEND_PATH is required when nanopb is also used by another
        # module (the app itself generates the studio protos).
        # include(nanopb) has include_guard(GLOBAL). If this module is processed
        # before the ZMK app's own include(nanopb), the app's include becomes a
        # no-op and FindNanopb never sets its APPEND_PATH default in the app's
        # scope -- which breaks the app's own studio.proto generation. Publish
        # the default through the cache so every caller sees it.
        if(NOT DEFINED NANOPB_GENERATE_CPP_APPEND_PATH)
            set(NANOPB_GENERATE_CPP_APPEND_PATH TRUE CACHE INTERNAL "nanopb default include path behavior")
        endif()
        list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH ${ZEPHYR_BASE}/modules/nanopb)
        include(nanopb)
        set(NANOPB_GENERATE_CPP_STANDALONE OFF)

        zephyr_library()
        file(GLOB_RECURSE PROTO_FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/proto/*.proto)
        nanopb_generate_cpp(proto_srcs proto_hdrs RELPATH ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
                            ${PROTO_FILES})
        target_include_directories(${ZEPHYR_CURRENT_LIBRARY} PUBLIC
                                   ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/proto)
        target_sources(${ZEPHYR_CURRENT_LIBRARY} PRIVATE ${proto_srcs} ${proto_hdrs})

        # Let the app (and thus src/dya_studio.c) include the generated headers.
        target_include_directories(app PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/proto)
        add_dependencies(app ${ZEPHYR_CURRENT_LIBRARY})
    endif()
endif()
